parts.desc: Tachometer pull-up to 12 V for the coil-on-plug case (JP5 fitted): the stock tachometer needs it once the igniter is gone. 2512, 1 W (0.2 W at 14.4 V)
Boost valve freewheel diode to the AUX +12 V pin (feed the valve from J5-15)
USB ESD protection
40 SMD lands, 2.54 mm, for the daughterboard's castellated bottom edge J2 (inputs + comms)

NOT FITTED: 5 V pull-up for the stock throttle switch contact on 2L (manual cars, R29 fitted). Fit (4.7k 0603, LCSC C23162; 1.1 mA with the switch closed) to read the stock switch; never with a sensor on 2L
12 V pull-up for the clutch switch input (the switch closes to ground; 48 mW at 15 V with it closed). The firmware reads the input active low
VVT-driver coil freewheel diode (to its +12 V feed, VBAT_IN)
CAN termination link: fitted = 120R terminator active; remove if the bus is terminated elsewhere
MAP supply

Leave OPEN with the stock igniter: it drives the tachometer and sends its signal to the ECU on 2I. Fit only after a coil-on-plug conversion with the igniter removed: the ECU then drives the tachometer through 2I (R37 is its 12 V pull-up; join the two tach wires at the old igniter plug). Shunt: 2.54 mm jumper cap (LCSC C5305), fitted by hand
MAP output filter
USB-C sink CC1
Idle valve freewheel diode (to its +12 V feed, VBAT_IN): keeps the PWM turn-off energy out of the driver
Resettable fuse for the LSU heater supply (LUTE 2920L300/30GR: 3 A hold, 5 A trip, 30 V)
12 V pull-up for the A/C request input (the switch closes to ground; 48 mW at 15 V with it closed). The firmware reads the input active low
Stock harness header, 48 pins (22 + 26). Hand-solder
MAP supply

Wideband sensor harness AEM 30-3427 (to a Bosch LSU 4.9). JST PUD side-entry header S08B-PUDSS-1. AEM pin: 1 trim (RT, green), 2 heater - (white), 3 common (VM, orange), 5 pump (IP, red), 6 sense (UN, black), 8 heater + (brown); 4 and 7 empty
NOT FITTED: 12 V pull-up for the vehicle speed input. Fit (4.7k 0603, LCSC C23162: 48 mW at 15 V with the signal low) only if your car's speed signal switches to ground or is open collector
Stock: 2L to the spare analog input AUX1 (remove for a TPS conversion)
NOT FITTED: TPS conversion only (manual cars): 2L to the TPS input, in place of R29. Never on an automatic: its sensor is on 2M

Airflow meter signal wire 2O: AFM = to the spare analog input (every year: the meter stays plugged in for its air-temperature sensor, and on 1989-93 its pump contact runs the fuel pump as stock). BOOST = the boost driver on that wire, only on a 1989-93 car whose airflow meter comes out: it then runs the fuel pump relay (link the meter plug's pump-contact cavity to its signal cavity, set the Fuel pump pin to the boost output). Shunt: 2.54 mm jumper cap (LCSC C5305), fitted by hand
Resettable fuse for the AUX +12 V pin J5-15 (BHFUSE BSMD1812-110-33V: 1.1 A hold, 2.2 A trip, 33 V, 1812; the daughterboard's F1 is the same part)
Nitrous arming input pull-down: an open wire reads "not armed"
Add-on I/O: COP 3/4, boost, alternator, main relay, knock, VR crank/cam, external AFR, flex-fuel sensor, nitrous arming switch, CAN for gauges, 5 V, +12 V (fused, F4)
USB-C for tuning and firmware (USB 2.0 FS)
CAN termination
Flex-fuel sensor signal pull-up to 5 V
40 SMD lands, 2.54 mm, for the daughterboard's castellated top edge J1 (power + outputs)
MAP sensor, 15-700 kPa absolute, single barbed port (case 867B). Lies flat, marking up, leads bent 90 deg, 2x M3 screws

NOT FITTED with a rev 0.10 or later daughterboard, which clamps the injectors itself. With a rev 0.9 daughterboard on a 1989-93 car: fit (SMCJ30A, SMC, LCSC C224048), clamp for the two injectors on 2U
USB-C sink CC2
NOT FITTED: TPS conversion only (manual cars): protected 5 V to 1N for a 0-5 V sensor on the stock plug. Never with the stock throttle switch: it shorts 1N to ground at idle

NOT FITTED with a rev 0.10 or later daughterboard, which clamps the injectors itself. With a rev 0.9 daughterboard on a 1989-93 car: fit (SMCJ30A, SMC, LCSC C224048), clamp for the two injectors on 2V

Year link (INJ3 94-95 on the silkscreen), fitted by JLCPCB on the 1994-95 boards. Injector 3 on its own wire 2Y (was JP1 on SEQ). Fitted on 1994-95. 1989-93: not fitted (the stock harness has two injectors on each of 2U and 2V, one driver each); fit it by hand only for a 1989-93 car rewired with one wire per injector

Year link (INJ4 94-95 on the silkscreen), fitted by JLCPCB on the 1994-95 boards. Injector 4 on its own wire 2Z (was JP2 on SEQ). Fitted on 1994-95. 1989-93: not fitted; NEVER on a 1989-93 automatic, where 2Z is the A/T control unit
Year link (FAN2 90-93 on the silkscreen), fitted by JLCPCB on the 1989-93 boards. Second fan relay output on 1R, the 1990-91 A/C fan (was JP3 on 90-93). Fitted on 1989-93
Year link (FAN2 94-95 on the silkscreen), fitted by JLCPCB on the 1994-95 boards. Second fan relay output on 2S, the condenser fan (was JP3 on 94-95). Fitted on 1994-95
Year link (2R 94-95 on the silkscreen), fitted by JLCPCB on the 1994-95 boards. Pressure regulator control solenoid on 2R (was JP4). Fitted on 1994-95
